candidates.sentence: Frank continues to oppose the Trump Administration’s callous attempts to roll back the ACA’s protections and undermine a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions.
Frank also believes that the right to vote is the foundation of our democracy.
He opposed the passage of the GOP tax scam that gave the ultra-wealthy a tax cut, and he continues to fight the repeal of the SALT deduction cap that hurts states like New Jersey.
He also knows that we must continue to honor our commitment to seniors who depend on Medicare and Social Security.
